svg.title: SponsorFlow Corrected Use Case Diagram
svg.desc: Five actors and twenty-seven unique use cases. Login and Logout are repeated representations of shared use cases. Actor associations have no arrowheads. Four dashed include or extend relationships point to their UML targets.
svg.text: UC-01 and UC-27 are repeated for readability.
They represent one shared Login use case
and one shared Logout use case.
